🔧 Hotfix: “Missing Game Executable” and Minor Fixes

- We've received several reports over the weekend about the game failing to launch after Friday's update. This hotfix should resolve the issue.
If you're still experiencing problems, please don’t hesitate to contact us at righthandlab.contact@gmail.com.
- Fixed dialogue line order in a couple of spots.
